title: Mrs. Vivien Hidary: "Parashat Teruma"

chapters.title: The vessels of the Beit HaMikdash
Ramban and Rambam on the Mishkan

summary: Mrs. Hidary explores the themes of Parashat Teruma by examining the spiritual significance of the Mishkan and its vessels. She discusses the different approaches of the Ramban and the Rambam regarding the purpose of the Mishkan and analyzes the meaning of the word teruma as an invitation to accept Hashem.
questions: How does the month of Adar provide strength to conquer inner enemies?
What is the difference between the Ramban's and the Rambam's view on the purpose of the Mishkan?
Why is the word teruma used to mean both a portion and a gift?
How do the proportions of the Mishkan relate to the human body?
